final: WITH pattern_avgs AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS cross_pattern_avg FROM pattern_avgs), above AS (SELECT pattern, avg_igg FROM pattern_avgs WHERE avg_igg > (SELECT cross_pattern_avg FROM overall)), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS avg_above FROM above) SELECT above.pattern, above.avg_igg, above.avg_igg - overall.cross_pattern_avg AS above_cross_pattern_avg, above.avg_igg - above_avg.avg_above AS from_above_patterns_avg FROM above CROSS JOIN overall CROSS JOIN above_avg
